verdict.rationale: Bento documents scoring every release against production history (offline, in CI, and on live traffic) to catch regressions. It also versions and diffs prompt and model changes, surfaces drift over prompt versions and regressions across deploys, and lets spans be tagged with experiment IDs. This covers regression detection between versions, but there is no evidence of a dedicated side-by-side comparison view for eval runs. missing for 10: explicit side-by-side eval-run comparison UI or CLI, documented eval run/dataset workflow, per-metric diffing between runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
